steps.title: Commercial Photorealism
steps.description: Standard AI models hallucinate details. Nano Banana preserves them. It respects the physics of light on glass, metal, and skin, making it the only choice for generating product assets that look like $10k studio shoots.

items.question: What is Nano Banana Pro?
items.answer: Nano Banana Pro is Lovart's proprietary high-fidelity AI model. Unlike general models (like SDXL or DALL-E), it is specifically fine-tuned for character consistency, photorealistic product rendering, and strict adherence to prompt constraints.

items.question: How do I ensure my character looks the same in every image?
items.answer: Simply upload a reference image of your character (or generate one you like) and use the '@' mention feature or 'Image Reference' slot. Nano Banana uses this as an anchor to maintain facial identity and clothing style across new prompts.

items.question: Can I use Nano Banana for commercial products?
items.answer: Yes. Nano Banana is the preferred model for commercial work on Lovart. All assets generated by paid users come with a full commercial license, making it perfect for ads, packaging, and merchandise.

items.question: Does Nano Banana support text rendering?
items.answer: While Nano Banana excels at realism, for complex text layouts, we recommend using Lovart's 'Seedream' model or the built-in Text Edit tool, which can be orchestrated together on the same canvas.

items.question: Is Nano Banana included in the free plan?
items.answer: Users can try Nano Banana with daily free credits. However, heavy usage and access to the 'Pro' version (with faster generation and higher resolution) are optimized for our paid subscription tiers.
